title.zh-CN: 腰痛伴进行性行走困难 · 63岁男性
title.en: Back pain and progressive difficulty walking · 63-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 63岁男性，乙肝肝硬化，腰痛、行走越来越困难已有一年半；此前按腰椎间盘问题做过按摩理疗，没有好转。
summary.en: A 63-year-old man with hepatitis B cirrhosis has had a year and a half of back pain and worsening walking; massage and physiotherapy for a presumed disc problem have not helped.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据上运动神经元体征（肌张力增高、腱反射亢进、Babinski征和Hoffmann征）及括约肌和感觉症状定位脊髓病，与腰椎间盘问题相区分，并开出颈、胸段脊髓MRI（NICE NG59，2016）。
learningOutcomes.en: Localise a myelopathy from upper motor neurone signs (tone, reflexes, Babinski and Hoffmann signs) with sphincter and sensory symptoms, tell it apart from a lumbar disc problem, and order MRI of the cervical and thoracic cord (NICE NG59, 2016).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从肾性糖尿、低分子量蛋白尿（α1微球蛋白）、NAG升高、低磷和低尿酸识别近端肾小管广泛功能障碍，并说明为什么肌酐会低估这种损伤（EASL 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise a generalised proximal tubulopathy from renal glycosuria, low-molecular-weight proteinuria (alpha-1 microglobulin), a raised NAG, hypophosphataemia and hypouricaemia, and explain why creatinine underestimates it (EASL 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据说明书（2018）把阿德福韦酯认定为迟发性范科尼综合征和骨软化症的原因，并说出我国2022年乙肝指南对服用阿德福韦酯或TDF者要求的监测。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify adefovir as a cause of delayed Fanconi syndrome and osteomalacia from its label (2018), and state the monitoring the Chinese 2022 hepatitis B guideline asks for in people taking adefovir or TDF.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为乙肝肝硬化患者当天把阿德福韦酯换成恩替卡韦或丙酚替诺福韦，按既往拉米夫定用药和肝功能选药定量，并解释为什么停用抗病毒药是危险的（EASL 2025；我国2022年指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Switch a patient with hepatitis B cirrhosis from adefovir to entecavir or tenofovir alafenamide on the same day, choosing drug and dose by previous lamivudine use and liver function, and explain why stopping antivirals is dangerous (EASL 2025; Chinese guideline 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在查过白蛋白校正钙、镁、甲状旁腺激素和维生素D之后，用口服补磷加活性维生素D处理低磷和骨骼，并说明为什么此时不用双膦酸盐和非甾体抗炎药。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat the phosphate and bones with oral phosphate and active vitamin D after checking albumin-adjusted calcium, magnesium, PTH and vitamin D, and explain why bisphosphonates and NSAIDs are avoided here.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用WHO-UMC系统评价因果关系，区分“很可能”的小管反应与尚未证实的神经机制；上报不良反应，并用复述法向患者说明计划。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess causality with the WHO-UMC system, separating a probable tubular reaction from an unproven neurological mechanism; report the reaction and explain the plan to the patient with teach-back.

notes.en: Adapted from a published single-patient report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, split up and reordered by phase and reworded into the patient's own speech; no value, timing, drug, sign or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and times are relative. The ward, the division into phases, when each test is ordered and reported, the ward staff and their dialogue, and the decisions, interventions, scoring and teaching points are educational design. Version 1.0.0 held the MRI and the neurophysiology in one record; this version splits them into two reports and places the 'mild degenerative change' with the MRI — an inference, listed for verification.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 腰痛，腿麻，走路越来越费劲
chiefComplaint.en: Back pain, numb legs and walking that keeps getting harder

triageNote.zh-CN: 63岁男性入院：腰痛、行走进行性困难一年半，双腿发麻出现得更早。既往乙肝肝硬化，做过食管静脉曲张套扎。目前行走需要有人搀扶。
triageNote.en: 63-year-old man admitted with a year and a half of low back pain and progressive difficulty walking; his legs went numb before that. Background of hepatitis B cirrhosis, with oesophageal varices banded. He currently needs someone to support him to walk.

personality.zh-CN: 63岁男性，乙肝肝硬化，躺在病房床上。走路一年比一年费劲，心里着急，但说话平和、配合，问什么答什么。知道自己长期吃的乙肝药叫什么、吃了多久，别的就说不清了。
personality.en: A 63-year-old man with hepatitis B cirrhosis, lying in a ward bed. His walking has been getting worse and he is worried, but he speaks calmly, cooperates and answers what he is asked. He knows the name of the hepatitis B tablet he takes and how long he has taken it, and little else about his treatment.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子不长；不用医学术语，只会照着说医生告诉过他的病名和药名（乙肝、肝硬化、静脉曲张、阿德福韦酯、腰椎间盘）。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences; no medical jargon beyond the names his doctors have used (hepatitis B, cirrhosis, varices, adefovir, a disc).

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我腰疼，两条腿发麻，走起路来就跟踩在棉花上一样。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my back hurts, my legs are numb, and walking feels like treading on cotton wool.

fallbackUnknown.en: I'm not sure about that, doctor.

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是腰椎间盘的毛病越来越重了？
concerns.en: Is the disc in my back getting worse?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 躺在床上，清醒、配合，用自己的话回答，只说问到的内容；不报任何数值、化验结果、剂量或日期，不知道的就说说不上来，不编。他不知道阿德福韦酯的剂量，也不知道以前有没有用过别的乙肝药、有没有定期查过肾。医生说要换药时，他最担心的是肝会不会出事。
actingNotes.en: Lying in bed, alert and cooperative; answers in his own words and only what is asked. He gives no numbers, test results, doses or dates, and when he does not know something he says so and never invents it. He does not know his adefovir dose, whether he took any other hepatitis B tablet before, or whether his kidneys were checked. When a change of medicine is mentioned, his first worry is whether his liver will be safe.

name.zh-CN: 原报告记录的后续经过
name.en: The reported subsequent course

date.en: Weeks to five months after the switch

text.zh-CN: 原报告记录：阿德福韦酯换为恩替卡韦，并补充相关营养和骨代谢治疗；血磷在数周内改善；5个月后恢复正常行走；尿小管指标明显下降，但部分仍异常。报告的诊断（文题）：阿德福韦酯相关范科尼综合征合并脊髓病及周围神经病。
text.en: The report records that adefovir was switched to entecavir, with nutritional and bone-metabolism treatment; the phosphate improved within weeks; at five months he was walking normally again; the urine tubular markers fell markedly, though some remained abnormal. The report's diagnosis (its title): adefovir dipivoxil–associated Fanconi syndrome with myelopathy and peripheral neuropathy.

note.zh-CN: 这里的记录没有恩替卡韦的剂量，没有写营养和骨代谢治疗用了什么药、多大剂量，没有换药后的血磷、肌酐或HBV DNA数值，也没有写哪些小管指标仍异常，以及5个月以后的情况。
note.en: As recorded here, the report gives no entecavir dose, does not name the nutritional or bone-metabolism drugs or their doses, gives no phosphate, creatinine or HBV DNA value after the switch, and does not say which tubular markers stayed abnormal or what happened after five months.

source.zh-CN: 1.0.0版报告事实：治疗及随访段；诊断取自文题
source.en: Report fact (version 1.0.0): treatment and follow-up section; the diagnosis is the article title

name.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯，当天换用恩替卡韦
name.en: Stop adefovir and start entecavir the same day

dose.zh-CN: 恩替卡韦口服，每日1次，空腹服用（餐后至少2小时、下一餐前至少2小时）：代偿期肝硬化、未用过拉米夫定者0.5 mg；失代偿期1 mg；肌酐清除率<50 mL/min时按说明书减量或延长间隔（恩替卡韦说明书）。与最后一次阿德福韦酯无缝衔接。
dose.en: Entecavir by mouth once daily on an empty stomach (at least 2 hours after a meal and 2 hours before the next): 0.5 mg in compensated cirrhosis without previous lamivudine; 1 mg in decompensated cirrhosis; reduced or spaced out if creatinine clearance is below 50 mL/min (Baraclude label). No gap after the last adefovir dose.

response.zh-CN: 已停用阿德福韦酯，开始服用恩替卡韦。原报告记录他换用了恩替卡韦，剂量没有记录；本病例不模拟用药效果。
response.en: Adefovir is stopped and entecavir started. The report records the switch to entecavir without its dose; this case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯，当天换用丙酚替诺福韦
name.en: Stop adefovir and start tenofovir alafenamide the same day

dose.zh-CN: 丙酚替诺福韦25 mg口服，每日1次，随餐服用；失代偿期（Child-Pugh B或C级）肝硬化不推荐使用（说明书）。适用于既往用过拉米夫定的患者。
dose.en: Tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg by mouth once daily with food; not recommended in decompensated (Child-Pugh B or C) cirrhosis (Vemlidy label). The choice when lamivudine has been used before.

response.zh-CN: 已停用阿德福韦酯，开始服用丙酚替诺福韦。原报告换用的是恩替卡韦；本病例不模拟用药效果。
response.en: Adefovir is stopped and tenofovir alafenamide started. The report switched to entecavir instead; this case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 口服补磷，加用活性维生素D
name.en: Oral phosphate with active vitamin D

dose.zh-CN: 口服磷制剂，分次随餐服用，加用骨化三醇等活性维生素D；剂量与肾内科、内分泌科商定，并根据血磷、白蛋白校正钙、甲状旁腺激素和碱性磷酸酶调整。
dose.en: Oral phosphate in divided doses with meals, plus an active vitamin D such as calcitriol; doses agreed with nephrology and endocrinology and adjusted to the phosphate, albumin-adjusted calcium, PTH and alkaline phosphatase.

response.zh-CN: 已开始补磷和活性维生素D。原报告记录给予了相关营养和骨代谢治疗，没有写具体药物和剂量；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Phosphate and active vitamin D are started. The report records nutritional and bone-metabolism treatment without naming the drugs or doses; this case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 请肝病科会诊抗病毒方案
name.en: Ask hepatology to review the antiviral plan

dose.zh-CN: 说明他的肝硬化、静脉曲张和用药情况，商定换药方案和HBV DNA监测。
dose.en: Describe his cirrhosis, varices and medicines, and agree the switch and the HBV DNA monitoring.

response.zh-CN: 肝病科医生会来看他，和你一起核对换药方案。本病例没有记录当时请过哪些科会诊。
response.en: The hepatologist will see him and go through the switch with you. This case does not record which teams were consulted.

name.zh-CN: 请肾内科会诊
name.en: Ask nephrology to review the kidney findings

dose.zh-CN: 说明血、尿结果，商定肾小管功能的进一步评估、补充治疗和随访指标。
dose.en: Present the blood and urine results and agree the further tubular work-up, replacement and follow-up markers.

response.zh-CN: 肾内科医生会来看他。本病例没有记录当时请过哪些科会诊。
response.en: The nephrologist will see him. This case does not record which teams were consulted.

name.zh-CN: 请临床药师核对用药和剂量
name.en: Ask the clinical pharmacist to review his medicines and doses

dose.zh-CN: 核对全部用药、肾功能和肝功能对剂量的影响，以及需要避免的肾毒性药物。
dose.en: Reconcile every medicine, check how his kidney and liver function affect the doses, and list nephrotoxic drugs to avoid.

response.zh-CN: 药师会核对他的用药。本病例没有记录药师是否参与。
response.en: The pharmacist will review his medicines. This case does not record whether a pharmacist was involved.

name.zh-CN: 评估跌倒风险：助行器、有人陪同下床、康复评估
name.en: Falls assessment: walking aid, supervised mobilising and a physiotherapy assessment

dose.zh-CN: 入院即评估跌倒风险（NICE NG249，2025：50岁及以上的高危人群），提供助行器，有人陪同下床；请康复科评估步态，不做脊柱推拿。
dose.en: Assess his falls risk on admission (NICE NG249, 2025: people 50 and over at higher risk), provide a walking aid and help to mobilise, and ask physiotherapy to assess his gait — no spinal manipulation.

response.zh-CN: 已落实防跌倒措施。本病例没有记录跌倒风险评估。
response.en: Falls precautions are in place. This case does not record a falls assessment.

name.zh-CN: 向他解释病情和换药，并请他复述要点
name.en: Explain the findings and the switch to him, and check he can repeat the key points

dose.zh-CN: 用通俗的话说明：肾脏在丢磷、丢糖、丢蛋白，最可能与阿德福韦酯有关；乙肝药是换，不是停，千万不要自己停药；新药怎么吃；补磷的药；之后要复查的血和尿；走路能恢复到什么程度还不确定。
dose.en: In plain words: his kidneys are losing phosphate, sugar and protein, most likely because of the adefovir; the hepatitis tablet is being changed, not stopped, and he must never stop it himself; how to take the new tablet; the phosphate tablets; the blood and urine tests to come; and that how far his walking will recover is still uncertain.

response.zh-CN: 他听完后复述了要点。本病例没有记录医生当时对他说了什么。
response.en: He listens and repeats the key points back. This case does not record what he was told.

name.zh-CN: 上报可疑药品不良反应
name.en: Report the suspected adverse drug reaction

dose.zh-CN: 通过医院药物警戒系统上报国家药品不良反应监测机构（《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》，2011）。
dose.en: Through the hospital's pharmacovigilance system to the national adverse-drug-reaction monitoring centre (China's Provisions for Adverse Drug Reaction Reporting and Monitoring, 2011).

response.zh-CN: 已上报。本病例没有记录当时是否上报过不良反应。
response.en: Reported. This case does not record whether the reaction was reported.

name.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯，暂停一切乙肝抗病毒治疗
name.en: Stop adefovir and hold all hepatitis B treatment

dose.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯，在肾功能和血磷恢复之前不用任何抗病毒药。
dose.en: Adefovir stopped, with no antiviral at all until the kidneys and phosphate recover.

harm.zh-CN: 肝硬化患者停用抗病毒治疗可诱发乙肝急性加重、肝功能失代偿甚至死亡：阿德福韦酯临床试验中停药后最多25%出现肝炎加重，说明书（2018）警示肝硬化者失代偿风险更高；EASL 2025指南建议，进展期肝病患者在HBsAg消失之前不应停用核苷（酸）类药物。应当当天换药，而不是停药。
harm.en: Stopping antiviral treatment in cirrhosis can bring on a hepatitis B flare, hepatic decompensation and death: in the adefovir trials, hepatitis exacerbations followed discontinuation in up to 25 % of patients, and the label (2018) warns that cirrhosis raises the risk of decompensation; EASL 2025 advises against stopping NAs in advanced liver disease before HBsAg loss. Switch the drug the same day instead of stopping it.

response.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯已停用，他现在没有任何乙肝抗病毒治疗。原报告没有这样做；本病例不模拟肝炎加重。
response.en: Adefovir is stopped and he now has no hepatitis B treatment at all. The report did not do this; this case does not simulate a flare.

name.zh-CN: 换用富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯（TDF）
name.en: Switch adefovir to tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF)

dose.zh-CN: 富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯口服，每日1次，替代阿德福韦酯。
dose.en: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate by mouth once daily in place of the adefovir.

harm.zh-CN: TDF同样经近端肾小管排泄，可引起范科尼综合征、低磷血症和骨量减少；EASL 2025指南在低磷血症和肾功能不全时优先推荐丙酚替诺福韦（或恩替卡韦），我国2022年指南对肾脏疾病患者不建议使用ADV或TDF。
harm.en: TDF is also handled by the proximal tubule and can cause Fanconi syndrome, hypophosphataemia and bone loss; EASL 2025 prefers tenofovir alafenamide (or entecavir) in hypophosphataemia and renal insufficiency, and the Chinese 2022 guideline advises against adefovir or TDF in kidney disease.

response.zh-CN: 已换用TDF。原报告换用的是恩替卡韦；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Switched to TDF. The report chose entecavir; this case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 继续阿德福韦酯，按肌酐清除率延长给药间隔
name.en: Continue adefovir at a dosing interval adjusted for creatinine clearance

dose.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯继续服用，按肌酐清除率改为隔日或更长间隔给药。
dose.en: Adefovir continued, spaced to every 48 hours or longer according to the creatinine clearance.

harm.zh-CN: 说明书的间隔调整针对的是肌酐清除率下降，不是药物已经造成的肾小管病；继续用药会让损伤持续。我国2022年指南：一旦确诊此类不良反应，应及时停药并换用其他药物，同时积极治疗；EASL 2025指南也不再推荐阿德福韦酯作为一线药物。
harm.en: The label's interval adjustment is for reduced creatinine clearance, not for a tubulopathy the drug has already caused; continuing it keeps the injury going. The Chinese 2022 guideline: once such a reaction is confirmed, stop the drug promptly, switch to another and treat the complication; EASL 2025 no longer recommends adefovir first line.

response.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯继续服用。原报告停用了阿德福韦酯；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Adefovir is continued. The report stopped it; this case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 双氯芬酸（非甾体抗炎药）止腰痛
name.en: Diclofenac (an NSAID) for the back pain

dose.zh-CN: 双氯芬酸50 mg口服，每日3次。
dose.en: Diclofenac 50 mg by mouth three times a day.

harm.zh-CN: 他有肝硬化和静脉曲张，肾小管又已经受损：非甾体抗炎药减少肾血流，可诱发急性肾损伤和消化道出血。阿德福韦酯说明书（2018）把非甾体抗炎药列为需要警惕的肾毒性合用药；NICE NG59（2016）要求用药前权衡胃肠、肝脏和心肾毒性。
harm.en: He has cirrhosis with varices and an injured tubule: NSAIDs cut renal blood flow and can bring on acute kidney injury and gastrointestinal bleeding. The adefovir label (2018) names NSAIDs among the nephrotoxic co-medications to beware of, and NICE NG59 (2016) asks that gastrointestinal, liver and cardio-renal toxicity be weighed first.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例不模拟它对肾脏和胃肠道的影响。
response.en: Given. This case does not simulate its effect on his kidneys or gut.

name.zh-CN: 继续按腰椎间盘问题做按摩和脊柱推拿
name.en: More massage and spinal manipulation for a lumbar disc problem

dose.zh-CN: 继续按腰椎间盘问题做按摩、推拿和牵引。
dose.en: Further massage, manipulation and traction for a presumed lumbar disc problem.

harm.zh-CN: 上运动神经元体征和小便失禁提示病变在脊髓，不是腰椎间盘；在查明脊髓病的原因之前做脊柱推拿可能加重损伤，而按摩理疗此前已经无效。NICE NG59（2016）要求先排除特殊原因，手法治疗只用于非特异性腰痛，并且只作为包含运动锻炼的综合方案的一部分。
harm.en: Upper motor neurone signs and urinary incontinence place the problem in the spinal cord, not a lumbar disc; manipulating the spine before the cause of a myelopathy is known risks further injury, and massage and physiotherapy have already failed. NICE NG59 (2016) asks that specific causes be excluded first and keeps manual therapy for non-specific low back pain, as part of a package that includes exercise.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。原报告记录他入院前做过按摩理疗，没有改善。
response.en: Booked. The report records massage and physiotherapy before admission, without improvement.

name.zh-CN: 腰椎硬膜外类固醇注射
name.en: Lumbar epidural steroid injection

dose.zh-CN: 腰椎硬膜外注射局麻药和类固醇。
dose.en: A lumbar epidural injection of local anaesthetic and steroid.

harm.zh-CN: 这是脊髓病变，不是腰椎神经根受压，注射的部位就是错的；他有肝硬化和脾大，血小板和凝血功能都没有记录，硬膜外穿刺可能形成血肿，造成永久截瘫。NICE NG59（2016）不建议用脊柱注射治疗腰痛。
harm.en: This is a cord lesion, not a compressed lumbar root, so the injection targets the wrong place; with cirrhosis and an enlarged spleen and no platelet count or clotting recorded, an epidural puncture risks a haematoma and permanent paraplegia. NICE NG59 (2016) does not recommend spinal injections for low back pain.

response.zh-CN: 已注射。原报告没有这样做；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The injection is given. The report did not do this; this case does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 了解他行走变差的经过

hint.zh-CN: 每个症状是什么时候出现的、先后顺序怎样？小便和胸口有什么感觉？他有哪些慢性病，长期吃什么药、吃了多久？之前做过什么治疗？
hint.en: When did each symptom start, and in what order? What about his bladder and his chest? Which long-term illnesses does he have, what does he take and for how long, and what has been tried already?

guidance.zh-CN: 他躺在病房床上，能自己回答问题。
guidance.en: He is lying in a ward bed and answers for himself.

hint.zh-CN: 上运动神经元还是下运动神经元？查肌张力、反射和病理反射——手也要查——再查肌力，看他走路。
hint.en: Upper or lower motor neurone? Check tone, reflexes and the pathological reflexes — the hands too — then power, and watch him walk.

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁查体；他下地走路需要有人扶。
guidance.en: Examine him at the bedside; he needs someone beside him to walk.

title.zh-CN: 判断病变部位，送出第一批检查
title.en: Decide where the problem lies and send the first tests

hint.zh-CN: 哪个层面的病变能解释全部体征？哪项影像能回答这个问题？还应该同时送哪些血、尿检查？
hint.en: Which level of the nervous system explains every sign? Which scan answers that, and which blood and urine tests belong with it?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答，并在入院时开出检查。
guidance.en: Answer on the case board, and place the orders while he is being admitted.

hint.zh-CN: 血糖正常时尿里为什么有糖？尿里的小分子蛋白和小管酶提示肾脏哪一段受损？肌酐够不够用来判断？影像和神经电生理又说明了什么？
hint.en: Why is there sugar in the urine when the blood sugar is normal? What do the small proteins and the tubular enzyme say about which part of the kidney is hurt, and is the creatinine enough to judge it? What do the scan and the neurophysiology add?

guidance.zh-CN: 结果和报告都在病历里，可在病历终端查看。
guidance.en: The results and reports are in his notes, at the records terminal.

hint.zh-CN: 哪种药必须换？换药的同时，他的乙肝绝不能出现什么情况？选药和定剂量之前要先知道什么？低磷和骨骼怎么处理，还需要请谁来看？
hint.en: Which medicine has to change, and what must not happen to his hepatitis B while it does? What do you need to know before choosing the drug and its dose? What do his phosphate and bones need, and who else should see him?

guidance.zh-CN: 仍在病房；可以开药、开检查、请会诊。
guidance.en: Still on the ward: you can prescribe, order tests and ask for reviews.

title.zh-CN: 安排随访，回看报告记录的经过
title.en: Plan the follow-up and review the reported course

hint.zh-CN: 什么能支持病因判断，什么证明不了？这次反应还应该告诉谁？最后把你的计划和原报告的记录比一比。
hint.en: What would support the cause, and what could not prove it? Who else needs to know about this reaction? Then set your plan beside what the report records.

guidance.zh-CN: 复盘阶段：后续经过记录在病历中。
guidance.en: Debrief stage: the later course is in his notes.

prompt.zh-CN: 施先生63岁，腰痛、行走越来越困难一年半；双腿发麻出现得更早，先左脚、后右腿；偶尔小便失禁，胸口有紧束感。按腰椎间盘问题做过按摩理疗，没有好转。查体：双下肢肌张力增高，膝反射亢进，双侧Babinski征和Hoffmann征阳性，肌力V级，步基稍宽、需要搀扶。病变在哪里？下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: Mr Shi, 63, has had a year and a half of back pain and worsening walking; his legs went numb before that, first the left foot, then the right leg; he is occasionally incontinent of urine and his chest feels tight and bound. Massage and physiotherapy for a disc problem did not help. On examination: increased tone in both legs, brisk knee reflexes, Babinski and Hoffmann signs positive on both sides, power grade V, and a slightly wide-based gait needing support. Where is the lesion, and what do you do next?

need.zh-CN: 先问清症状的经过（包括小便），并查肌张力、Babinski征和Hoffmann征。
need.en: First take the story (including his bladder) and examine tone, the plantar responses and the Hoffmann sign.

text.zh-CN: 颈髓或更高水平的脊髓病变，运动和感觉传导束都受累：尽快做颈、胸段脊髓MRI，同时查血、尿，寻找代谢和药物原因
text.en: A spinal cord lesion at neck level or higher, affecting motor and sensory tracts: urgent MRI of the cervical and thoracic cord, with blood and urine tests for metabolic and drug causes

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。肌张力增高、腱反射亢进、Babinski征阳性都是上运动神经元体征，压迫腰段神经根的腰椎间盘解释不了；双侧Hoffmann征提示病变在颈髓或更高水平，小便失禁和胸部紧束感又说明括约肌和感觉通路受累。首先要用颈、胸段脊髓MRI排除压迫；体征涉及不止一个节段、运动和感觉传导束同时受累，还要想到营养、中毒、代谢等全身性原因，所以血、尿检查要同时送。NICE NG59（2016）要求在把腰痛当作非特异性腰痛处理之前先排除特殊原因。
feedback.en: Right. Increased tone, brisk reflexes and Babinski signs are upper motor neurone signs, which a lumbar disc pressing on nerve roots cannot produce; bilateral Hoffmann signs put the lesion at or above the cervical cord, and the incontinence and the tight, bound chest add sphincter and sensory involvement. Exclude compression first with MRI of the cervical and thoracic cord; signs at more than one level, with motor and sensory tracts both affected, also raise systemic causes — nutritional, toxic, metabolic — so send the blood and urine tests at the same time. NICE NG59 (2016) asks that specific causes be excluded before back pain is managed as non-specific.

text.zh-CN: 腰椎间盘突出压迫双侧神经根：做腰椎MRI，证实突出后行硬膜外类固醇注射，效果不好再考虑减压手术
text.en: A lumbar disc prolapse compressing nerve roots on both sides: MRI of the lumbar spine, then an epidural steroid injection if it shows a prolapse, and decompression if that fails

feedback.zh-CN: 腰椎间盘压迫的是脊髓末端以下的神经根，表现为下运动神经元体征——反射减弱、肌萎缩、按神经根分布的无力——而不是肌张力增高、膝反射亢进和Babinski征、Hoffmann征。腰椎MRI会漏掉更高位置的脊髓病变，硬膜外注射或腰椎手术治错了部位；NICE NG59（2016）也不建议用脊柱注射治疗腰痛。
feedback.en: A lumbar disc compresses nerve roots below the end of the cord and gives lower motor neurone signs — reduced reflexes, wasting, weakness in a root pattern — not increased tone, brisk knee jerks or Babinski and Hoffmann signs. A lumbar MRI would miss a cord lesion higher up, an epidural injection or lumbar surgery would treat the wrong level, and NICE NG59 (2016) does not recommend spinal injections for low back pain.

text.zh-CN: 肝病引起的长度依赖性周围神经病：门诊安排神经传导检查，先补充B族维生素，结果出来后再到门诊复查
text.en: A length-dependent peripheral neuropathy from his liver disease: nerve conduction studies as an outpatient, vitamin B supplements for now, and a clinic review when the results are back

feedback.zh-CN: 单纯的周围神经病使反射减弱、足底反射正常屈曲，不会出现肌张力增高、膝反射亢进以及Babinski征、Hoffmann征；它引起的感觉障碍也很少伴有小便失禁和胸部紧束感。周围神经病可以同时存在，但上运动神经元体征和括约肌障碍要求现在就做脊髓影像，而不是门诊随访。
feedback.en: A neuropathy alone lowers the reflexes and leaves the plantars flexor; it cannot cause increased tone, brisk knee jerks or Babinski and Hoffmann signs, and its sensory loss rarely brings incontinence or a tight, bound chest. A neuropathy may coexist, but the upper motor neurone signs and the sphincter disturbance need the cord imaged now, not an outpatient review.

text.zh-CN: 肝硬化门体分流引起的肝性脊髓病：不必再做其他检查，转诊评估肝移植，同时做康复训练缓解下肢僵硬
text.en: Hepatic myelopathy from portosystemic shunting in his cirrhosis: no further tests are needed, so refer him for transplant assessment and give physiotherapy for the stiff legs

feedback.zh-CN: 肝硬化伴门体分流时确实会出现肝性脊髓病，但它是排除性诊断：典型表现是缓慢进展的双下肢痉挛性无力，感觉障碍轻，括约肌功能大多保留。他从脚开始的麻木、小便失禁和胸部紧束感都不太符合；而压迫、营养缺乏、感染和药物等原因是可以治疗的——先做脊髓影像和检查，再下结论。
feedback.en: Hepatic myelopathy does occur in cirrhosis with portosystemic shunting, but it is a diagnosis of exclusion: typically a slowly progressive spastic weakness of the legs, with little sensory loss and sphincters largely spared. His numbness from the feet up, the incontinence and the tight, bound chest fit poorly, and compressive, nutritional, infective and drug causes are treatable — image the cord and test before labelling it.

prompt.zh-CN: 血：磷0.37 mmol/L，尿酸122 μmol/L，钙1.97 mmol/L，肌酐119 μmol/L，空腹血糖4.5 mmol/L。尿：尿糖阳性，尿蛋白阳性，α1微球蛋白257.8 mg/L（参考0–12.8），NAG 90 U/L（参考2–20）。结合他的病史，怎样解释这些结果？
prompt.en: Blood: phosphate 0.37 mmol/L, urate 122 μmol/L, calcium 1.97 mmol/L, creatinine 119 μmol/L, fasting glucose 4.5 mmol/L. Urine: glucose positive, protein positive, alpha-1 microglobulin 257.8 mg/L (reference 0–12.8), NAG 90 U/L (reference 2–20). Taken with his history, what explains these results?

need.zh-CN: 先问清他长期吃的药，并在本阶段看过血生化和尿液结果。
need.en: First ask what he takes long-term, and read this stage's blood chemistry and urine results.

text.zh-CN: 近端肾小管广泛功能障碍（范科尼综合征）：葡萄糖、磷、尿酸和小分子蛋白从尿中丢失，最可能由长期服用的阿德福韦酯引起
text.en: Generalised proximal tubule failure (Fanconi syndrome) — glucose, phosphate, urate and small proteins lost in the urine — most likely caused by his long-term adefovir

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。空腹血糖4.5 mmol/L时尿糖阳性，是肾性糖尿；α1微球蛋白明显升高是低分子量（肾小管性）蛋白尿，NAG升高提示小管上皮损伤；再加上低磷和低尿酸，这是近端肾小管的广泛功能障碍。阿德福韦酯说明书（2018）列有范科尼综合征、近端肾小管病、低磷血症和骨软化症，而且这种毒性可以在平稳服药多年后才出现。肌酐119 μmol/L低估了损伤：EASL 2025指南指出，单看肌酐可能反映不出肾小管损害。
feedback.en: Right. Glucose in the urine with a fasting glucose of 4.5 mmol/L is renal glycosuria; a high alpha-1 microglobulin is low-molecular-weight (tubular) proteinuria and a raised NAG marks tubular cell injury; with a low phosphate and a low urate, this is generalised proximal tubule failure. Adefovir's label (2018) lists Fanconi syndrome, proximal tubulopathy, hypophosphataemia and osteomalacia, and the toxicity can appear after years of uneventful treatment. A creatinine of 119 μmol/L understates the damage: EASL 2025 notes that creatinine alone may not reflect tubular injury.

text.zh-CN: 未诊断的糖尿病合并糖尿病肾病：尿糖和尿蛋白来自餐后高血糖，应查糖化血红蛋白，并开始口服降糖药控制血糖
text.en: Undiagnosed diabetes with diabetic kidney disease: the glucose and protein in the urine come from high sugars after meals, so check the HbA1c and start a diabetes tablet

feedback.zh-CN: 他的空腹血糖是4.5 mmol/L，尿糖是肾性的，不是血糖高溢出来的；糖尿病肾病表现为白蛋白尿，不会出现α1微球蛋白显著升高伴低磷、低尿酸。对血糖正常的肝硬化患者用降糖药，有低血糖风险，病因却原封不动。
feedback.en: His fasting glucose is 4.5 mmol/L, so the glycosuria is renal, not overflow from high blood sugar; diabetic kidney disease gives albuminuria, not a raised alpha-1 microglobulin with low phosphate and urate. A diabetes tablet in a man with cirrhosis and a normal glucose risks hypoglycaemia and leaves the cause untouched.

text.zh-CN: 晚期肝硬化引起的肝肾综合征：肾脏是因为肝病而衰竭，应给予白蛋白和特利加压素，并转诊评估肝移植
text.en: Hepatorenal syndrome from advanced cirrhosis: his kidneys are failing because of his liver, so give albumin and terlipressin and refer him for a transplant assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 肝肾综合征是功能性肾衰竭，尿液“干净”——没有肾性糖尿，没有小管性蛋白尿——诊断依赖肌酐的急性升高。按国际腹水俱乐部的标准（EASL 2018失代偿期肝硬化指南采用），存在蛋白尿等肾实质损伤证据或正在使用肾毒性药物时，不能诊断肝肾综合征；他只有一次肌酐119 μmol/L，尿里却有糖和小分子蛋白，还在服用阿德福韦酯。特利加压素有缺血和容量负荷过重的风险，这里没有指征。
feedback.en: Hepatorenal syndrome is a functional kidney failure with a bland urine — no renal glycosuria, no tubular proteinuria — diagnosed from an acute rise in creatinine. Under the International Club of Ascites criteria (adopted by EASL 2018 for decompensated cirrhosis), proteinuria or other structural injury, or a current nephrotoxic drug, rules it out; he has a single creatinine of 119 μmol/L, glucose and small proteins in the urine, and is taking adefovir. Terlipressin carries ischaemic and fluid-overload risks and is not indicated.

text.zh-CN: 肝硬化进食少、营养不良，足以解释低磷、低尿酸和低钙；尿液改变是偶然发现，下次门诊复查一下即可
text.en: Poor intake and malnutrition from cirrhosis explain the low phosphate, urate and calcium; the urine changes are incidental and can simply be rechecked at his next clinic visit

feedback.zh-CN: 营养不良造成的低磷，肾脏会尽力把磷留住——尿里应当磷很少，也没有糖和小分子蛋白。血糖正常时出现尿糖、α1微球蛋白和NAG升高，说明肾脏在丢失本该回收的物质；把它们推到门诊，等于让肾毒性药物继续用下去。
feedback.en: Malnutrition lowers phosphate while the kidney conserves it — the urine should then hold little phosphate, no glucose and no small proteins. Glycosuria at a normal blood glucose, a high alpha-1 microglobulin and a raised NAG say the kidney is losing what it should keep; deferring them leaves a nephrotoxic drug running.

text.zh-CN: 服药五年多都没事，不太可能是阿德福韦酯：先按骨髓瘤轻链所致的肾小管病处理，血液科结果回来前抗病毒药不变
text.en: Adefovir is unlikely after five uneventful years: treat this as a myeloma light-chain tubulopathy, and keep the antiviral unchanged until the haematology tests are back

feedback.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯的肾小管毒性恰恰是迟发的——随服药年限累积，说明书（2018）描述的就是迟发性肾毒性。成人新出现范科尼表现时，筛查单克隆轻链是合理的，但不应因此推迟撤掉最可能的病因。
feedback.en: Adefovir's tubular toxicity is typically delayed — it builds up over years of treatment, and the label (2018) describes nephrotoxicity of delayed onset. Screening for a monoclonal light chain is reasonable in an adult with a new Fanconi picture, but it should not hold up removing the likeliest cause.

prompt.zh-CN: 肾小管损伤最可能与阿德福韦酯有关。他有乙肝肝硬化和静脉曲张；HBV DNA还没有查，以前用过哪些乙肝药也不清楚。他的抗病毒治疗怎么办？
prompt.en: The tubular injury is most likely from adefovir. He has hepatitis B cirrhosis with varices; his HBV DNA has not been measured, and which hepatitis B drugs he had before is unknown. What do you do with his antiviral treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先解释血、尿结果，并问清他的肝病情况。
need.en: First interpret the blood and urine results, and ask about his liver disease.

text.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯，当天换用恩替卡韦（用过拉米夫定则换丙酚替诺福韦）；同时查HBV DNA、肝功能，核实既往用药
text.en: Stop adefovir and start entecavir the same day — tenofovir alafenamide if he has had lamivudine — while checking HBV DNA, liver function and his earlier drugs

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。EASL 2025指南在低磷血症和肾功能不全时优先推荐丙酚替诺福韦，恩替卡韦为替代；从阿德福韦酯换药时，只有既往没有用过拉米夫定才推荐恩替卡韦。我国2022年指南建议，已用阿德福韦酯或TDF的患者出现肾脏或骨骼疾病时改用恩替卡韦或TAF。换药不能留空档。恩替卡韦空腹服用，代偿期0.5 mg、失代偿期1 mg，肌酐清除率<50 mL/min时调整（说明书）；TAF说明书不推荐用于Child-Pugh B、C级肝硬化——所以肝功能和既往用药决定选哪种药、用多大剂量。
feedback.en: Right. EASL 2025 prefers tenofovir alafenamide in hypophosphataemia and renal insufficiency, with entecavir as the alternative, and after adefovir recommends entecavir only if lamivudine was not used before; the Chinese 2022 guideline advises changing adefovir or TDF to entecavir or TAF when kidney or bone disease develops. Switch without a gap. Entecavir is taken on an empty stomach, 0.5 mg in compensated and 1 mg in decompensated disease, adjusted below a creatinine clearance of 50 mL/min (label); the TAF label does not recommend it in Child-Pugh B or C cirrhosis — so his liver function and earlier drugs decide the drug and the dose.

text.zh-CN: 停用阿德福韦酯，暂停所有乙肝治疗，等肾功能和血磷恢复、复查血都正常以后，再重新开始抗病毒
text.en: Stop adefovir and pause all hepatitis B treatment until his kidneys and phosphate have recovered, then restart an antiviral once his blood tests are back to normal

feedback.zh-CN: 肝硬化患者停用抗病毒治疗会引来肝炎加重：阿德福韦酯试验中停药后最多25%的患者出现肝炎加重，肝硬化者发生失代偿的风险更高，并有死亡报告（说明书，2018）。EASL 2025指南建议进展期肝病患者在HBsAg消失前不要停用核苷（酸）类药物。肾脏需要的不是“停药休息”，而是换一种药。
feedback.en: Stopping antiviral treatment in cirrhosis invites a flare: in the adefovir trials hepatitis exacerbations followed discontinuation in up to 25 % of patients, and patients with cirrhosis are at higher risk of decompensation, with deaths reported (label, 2018). EASL 2025 advises against stopping NAs in advanced liver disease before HBsAg loss. The kidney does not need a drug holiday — it needs a different drug.

text.zh-CN: 继续服用阿德福韦酯，但按肌酐清除率延长给药间隔；三个月后复查尿液和血磷，看损伤是否稳定下来
text.en: Keep adefovir but lengthen the dosing interval to match his creatinine clearance, then recheck his urine and phosphate in three months to see whether things have settled

feedback.zh-CN: 说明书的给药间隔调整针对的是肌酐清除率下降，不是药物已经造成的肾小管病；继续用药，损伤就会继续。我国2022年指南写明：一旦确诊此类不良反应，应及时停药并换用其他药物，同时积极治疗。
feedback.en: The label's interval adjustments are for reduced clearance, not for a tubulopathy the drug has caused; continuing it leaves the injury running. The Chinese 2022 guideline says that once such a reaction is confirmed, the drug should be stopped promptly and replaced, with active treatment of the complication.

text.zh-CN: 换用富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯（TDF），它比阿德福韦酯更强效、耐药屏障高；下次常规随访时再复查肾功能
text.en: Switch to tenofovir disoproxil fumarate, which is more potent than adefovir with a high barrier to resistance, and recheck his kidney function at the next routine visit

feedback.zh-CN: TDF同样是核苷酸类似物，经近端肾小管排泄，可引起同样的范科尼综合征和骨量丢失；EASL 2025指南在低磷血症和肾功能不全时优先推荐TAF（或恩替卡韦），我国2022年指南对肾脏疾病患者不建议使用阿德福韦酯或TDF。
feedback.en: Tenofovir disoproxil is also a nucleotide analogue handled by the proximal tubule and can cause the same Fanconi syndrome and bone loss; EASL 2025 prefers TAF (or entecavir) in hypophosphataemia and renal insufficiency, and the Chinese 2022 guideline advises against adefovir or TDF in kidney disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 他的血磷0.37 mmol/L，总钙1.97 mmol/L；白蛋白、镁、碱性磷酸酶、甲状旁腺激素和维生素D都没有记录结果。除了换抗病毒药，他的低磷和骨骼怎么处理？
prompt.en: His phosphate is 0.37 mmol/L and his total calcium 1.97 mmol/L; no albumin, magnesium, alkaline phosphatase, PTH or vitamin D result is recorded. Besides the antiviral switch, how do you treat his phosphate and his bones?

need.en: First interpret the blood and urine results.

text.zh-CN: 分次口服补磷，加用活性维生素D；用药前先查白蛋白校正钙、镁、碱性磷酸酶、甲状旁腺激素和维生素D，疼痛部位拍片
text.en: Replace phosphate by mouth in divided doses with active vitamin D, after checking albumin-adjusted calcium, magnesium, ALP, PTH and vitamin D, and X-ray painful bones

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。换药后肾小管的丢失还会持续一段时间，丢掉的磷要补回来；分次口服磷制剂加活性维生素D（如骨化三醇）是低磷性骨软化症的常规处理，我国2022年指南也要求确诊此类不良反应后积极给予相应治疗。先查白蛋白、镁和甲状旁腺激素，因为没有白蛋白就无法判断1.97 mmol/L的总钙；还要找假骨折线——阿德福韦酯说明书（2018）指出骨软化症可表现为骨痛。
feedback.en: Right. The tubular leak goes on for a while after the switch, so the losses must be replaced; oral phosphate in divided doses with an active vitamin D such as calcitriol is the usual treatment for hypophosphataemic osteomalacia, and the Chinese 2022 guideline asks for active treatment once such a drug reaction is confirmed. Check the albumin, magnesium and PTH first, because a total calcium of 1.97 mmol/L cannot be read without the albumin, and look for pseudofractures: the adefovir label (2018) notes osteomalacia presenting as bone pain.

text.zh-CN: 按骨质疏松引起的腰痛处理：静脉输注唑来膦酸，之后长期口服钙片和普通维生素D，用来保护骨骼
text.en: Treat presumed osteoporosis as the cause of the back pain: intravenous zoledronic acid, then calcium and plain vitamin D tablets long term to protect the bones

feedback.zh-CN: 骨痛伴低磷提示骨软化症——矿化障碍，双膦酸盐治不了。唑来膦酸说明书把低钙血症和肌酐清除率<35 mL/min列为禁忌；他的总钙1.97 mmol/L而白蛋白未知，肾脏也已受损。应先纠正低磷和维生素D，再评估骨骼。
feedback.en: Bone pain with a low phosphate suggests osteomalacia — a mineralisation defect a bisphosphonate does not treat. The zoledronic acid label contraindicates it in hypocalcaemia and with a creatinine clearance below 35 mL/min; his total calcium is 1.97 mmol/L with the albumin unknown, and his kidneys are injured. Correct the phosphate and vitamin D first, then reassess the bones.

text.zh-CN: 只补碳酸钙和普通维生素D（胆骨化醇），按骨质疏松常规处理；阿德福韦酯换掉以后就不用再额外补磷了
text.en: Calcium carbonate with plain vitamin D (colecalciferol) only, as for osteoporosis; phosphate tablets are unnecessary once the adefovir has been stopped and replaced

feedback.zh-CN: 普通维生素D和钙补不了小管还在丢失的磷，而受损的近端小管合成活性维生素D也减少；换药后数周内血磷仍低，骨骼仍然矿化不足。要直接补磷，并用活性维生素D。
feedback.en: Plain vitamin D and calcium do not replace the phosphate the tubule is still wasting, and the injured proximal tubule makes less active vitamin D; the phosphate stays low for weeks after the switch while the bone stays undermineralised. Replace phosphate directly and use an active vitamin D.

text.zh-CN: 不必补充：单靠换药，几天之内血磷就会自己恢复；一周后复查一次，到时候仍然偏低再开始处理
text.en: No supplements: the switch alone will correct the phosphate within a few days, so recheck his blood in a week and only treat it if it is still low then

feedback.zh-CN: 撤药后肾小管恢复需要数周到数月，而且可能不完全；血磷0.37 mmol/L、伴腰痛和行走困难，现在就需要补充。我国2022年指南把停药换药与积极治疗不良反应放在一起要求。
feedback.en: Tubular recovery after withdrawal takes weeks to months and may be incomplete, and a phosphate of 0.37 mmol/L with back pain and failing walking needs replacing now; the Chinese 2022 guideline pairs stopping the drug with active treatment of the reaction.

prompt.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯换掉、补磷开始以后：MRI未见胸段髓外占位，有轻度退变；神经电生理示双下肢深感觉传导径路阻滞。你怎样判断阿德福韦酯与他的肾脏和脊髓问题有没有因果关系？之后怎样随访？
prompt.en: Once adefovir has been replaced and phosphate replacement started: the MRI showed no thoracic extramedullary mass and mild degenerative change, and the neurophysiology impaired deep-sensation conduction in both legs. How will you judge whether adefovir caused his kidney and spinal cord problems, and what follow-up does he need?

need.zh-CN: 先定好抗病毒和补磷方案，并看过MRI和神经电生理报告。
need.en: First settle the antiviral and phosphate plans, and read the MRI and neurophysiology reports.

text.zh-CN: 数月内追踪血磷、尿糖、小管标志物、肌酐、HBV DNA和行走；好转可把小管病判为“很可能”由药物引起，但脊髓病的其他原因还要查
text.en: Track phosphate, urine glucose, tubular markers, creatinine, HBV DNA and his walking for months; recovery would make the drug a probable cause of the tubulopathy, while other cord causes are still sought

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。按WHO-UMC因果关系评价，时间关系合理、撤药后反应合理、又没有更好的解释，不需要再激发就可评为“很可能”。肾小管的关联有已知毒性作基础；脊髓的关联要弱一些，因为换药和补磷、骨代谢治疗同时进行，二者的作用分不开——所以维生素B12、铜、HIV、梅毒、HTLV-1仍要有结果，肝性脊髓病也不能放下。小管指标可能比血磷恢复得慢，换药后还要保证HBV DNA持续抑制（EASL 2025：达到病毒学应答前每3–6个月查一次）。
feedback.en: Right. On the WHO-UMC system, a plausible time course, a reasonable response to withdrawal and no better explanation make a reaction 'probable' without rechallenge. The tubular link rests on a known toxicity; the cord link is weaker, because the switch and the phosphate and bone treatment happen together and their effects cannot be separated — so B12, copper, HIV, syphilis and HTLV-1 still need results, and hepatic myelopathy stays in view. Tubular markers can lag behind the phosphate, and HBV DNA must stay suppressed on the new drug (EASL 2025: every 3–6 months until a virological response).

text.zh-CN: 等他恢复以后，短期重新服用阿德福韦酯做激发试验：再次出现就能证明因果，如果没事，以后可以放心长期服用
text.en: Once he has recovered, restart adefovir for a short trial: a relapse would prove the link, and if nothing happens he can safely stay on it long term

feedback.zh-CN: 用一种已经引起范科尼综合征、可能还累及脊髓的药物去故意再激发，会让他承担严重甚至不可逆的风险，却换不来任何临床好处——更安全的有效药物就在手边。WHO-UMC的“很可能”等级本来就不需要再激发。
feedback.en: Deliberately rechallenging with a drug that caused Fanconi syndrome, and possibly a myelopathy, exposes him to serious and perhaps irreversible harm for no clinical gain — safer effective antivirals are at hand. The WHO-UMC 'probable' category does not require rechallenge.

text.zh-CN: 血磷一回到正常范围就停止小管指标随访：血磷正常说明肾损伤已经完全恢复，以后不需要再查肾脏了
text.en: Stop the tubular tests once his serum phosphate is back in range, because a normal phosphate shows the kidney damage has fully healed and needs no further checks

feedback.zh-CN: 补磷时血磷可以先恢复正常，而小管仍在漏；恢复常常不完全，所以尿糖、尿蛋白、小管标志物和肌酐要随访到稳定为止——换药后还要监测HBV DNA。
feedback.en: Serum phosphate can normalise on supplements while the tubule still leaks; recovery is often partial, so urine glucose, protein, tubular markers and creatinine need following until they are stable — and HBV DNA must be watched on the new drug.

text.zh-CN: 如果换药以后行走恢复，就证明阿德福韦酯直接损伤了脊髓，脊髓病的其他原因也就都不需要再去查了
text.en: If his walking recovers after the switch, that proves adefovir damaged the spinal cord directly, so the other causes of myelopathy no longer need to be looked for

feedback.zh-CN: 撤药后好转支持存在关联，却证明不了直接的作用机制：补磷和骨代谢治疗是同时开始的，低磷本身也会影响神经和肌肉。可以治疗的脊髓病病因仍然要有检查结果。
feedback.en: Improvement after withdrawal supports an association but cannot prove a direct mechanism: the phosphate and bone treatment started at the same time, and low phosphate itself can affect nerves and muscles. Treatable causes of myelopathy still need their results.

text.zh-CN: 脊髓表现与药物无关，是退行性病变造成的：如果换药三个月后行走仍没有改善，就转脊柱外科做减压手术
text.en: The cord findings are unrelated degenerative disease: refer him for spinal decompression if his walking has not improved within three months of the switch

feedback.zh-CN: 报告只写了胸段未见髓外占位、轻度退变——没有需要减压的东西；减压手术需要一个与体征相符的压迫性病变，而Hoffmann征指向的颈髓是否扫到，报告并没有写。对轻度退变做手术只有风险没有目标；应继续排查可治疗的病因，并观察撤药后的反应。
feedback.en: The report showed no thoracic extramedullary mass and only mild degenerative change — nothing to decompress. Surgery needs a compressive lesion that matches the signs, and whether the cervical cord, where the Hoffmann signs point, was imaged is not recorded. Operating on mild degeneration brings risk without a target; keep testing for treatable causes and follow the response to withdrawal.

text.zh-CN: 问清腰痛、行走困难和腿麻的时间与先后，小便、大便和胸部的感觉，手的情况，以及之前的治疗
text.en: Asked the timing and order of the back pain, walking difficulty and numbness, about his bladder, bowels and chest, his hands, and the treatment already tried

text.zh-CN: 问清肝病和套扎史、阿德福韦酯用了多久、以前用过哪些乙肝药、是否监测过肾功能，以及其他用药和过敏
text.en: Asked about the liver disease and banding, how long he has taken adefovir, his earlier hepatitis B drugs, any kidney monitoring, other medicines and allergies

text.zh-CN: 查了下肢肌张力、膝反射、Babinski征、双手Hoffmann征、肌力和步态
text.en: Examined leg tone, knee reflexes, plantar responses, Hoffmann signs in both hands, power and gait

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把病变定位在脊髓而非腰椎间盘，并选对下一步检查（决策 1）
text.en: Placed the lesion in the spinal cord rather than a lumbar disc, with the right next tests, at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 入院评估时就开出颈、胸段脊髓MRI，并同时送血生化和尿液小管检查
text.en: During the admission assessment, ordered MRI of the cervical and thoracic cord together with the blood chemistry and urine tubular tests

text.zh-CN: 在结果回报阶段看了血生化、尿液结果、MRI报告和神经电生理报告
text.en: Read the blood chemistry, the urine results, the MRI report and the neurophysiology report when they came back

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认出近端肾小管病及其最可能的药物原因（决策 2）
text.en: Recognised the proximal tubulopathy and its likeliest drug cause at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 开出查找病因和评估小管功能的检查：尿磷排泄、血气、维生素B12与铜、HIV/梅毒/HTLV-1血清学
text.en: Ordered the tests for other causes and for tubular function: urine phosphate excretion, a blood gas, B12 and copper, and HIV, syphilis and HTLV-1 serology

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对抗病毒调整方案（决策 3），并开出HBV DNA和肝功能、凝血、血小板检查
text.en: Chose the right antiviral plan at the first attempt (decision 3) and ordered HBV DNA and liver function, clotting and platelets

text.zh-CN: 看到血、尿结果后、查看结局记录之前，就把阿德福韦酯换成恩替卡韦或丙酚替诺福韦，中间不留空档
text.en: After reading the blood and urine results and before reading the outcome record, replaced adefovir with entecavir or tenofovir alafenamide, leaving no gap

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对低磷与骨骼的处理（决策 4），开始补磷和活性维生素D，并查了骨代谢指标
text.en: Chose the right phosphate and bone plan at the first attempt (decision 4), started phosphate with active vitamin D and ordered the bone profile

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即说清怎样判断因果和随访（决策 5），并上报药品不良反应
text.en: Explained how to judge causality and follow him up at the first attempt (decision 5), and reported the adverse drug reaction

text.zh-CN: 请肝病科、肾内科和临床药师参与，落实防跌倒措施，并向他解释换药、确认他能复述
text.en: Brought in hepatology, nephrology and the pharmacist, put falls precautions in place, and explained the switch to him with teach-back

text.zh-CN: 没有停用全部抗病毒药，没有做硬膜外注射或脊柱推拿，没有换用TDF、继续阿德福韦酯或给非甾体抗炎药
text.en: Did not stop all antivirals, give an epidural injection or manipulate the spine, and did not switch to TDF, continue adefovir or give an NSAID

text.zh-CN: 用通俗的话向他说明肾脏和脊髓的问题、为什么换药而不是停药，以及仍不确定的地方，并确认他听懂了
text.en: Explained in plain words the kidney and spinal cord problems, why the medicine is changed rather than stopped and what remains uncertain, and checked he understood

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge框架评价与施先生的谈话。开始：介绍自己，确认他愿意现在谈，必要时请家人在场。了解：先问他已经知道什么、最担心什么（“以后还能走路吗？”“是不是腰椎间盘越来越重？”）。说明：用通俗的话讲——问题不在腰椎间盘，而在脊髓和肾脏；肾脏在丢磷、丢糖、丢蛋白，最可能与吃了五年半的阿德福韦酯有关，这是这种药已知的副作用；乙肝药是“换”不是“停”，自己停药可能让肝炎突然加重；新药怎么吃（恩替卡韦空腹）；补磷的药；之后要定期查血、查尿和HBV DNA；还要做哪些检查排除其他原因。如实说明不确定：行走能恢复多少、药物是否直接伤到脊髓，现在都说不准，不作虚假保证。回应情绪，留出提问时间；请他用自己的话复述关键点（尤其“绝不自己停乙肝药”）。不要责怪以前开药或治疗的医生；说明这次反应会按规定上报。本病例没有记录医生当时对他说了什么。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the conversation with Mr Shi against the Calgary–Cambridge guide. Initiating: introduce yourself, check he is ready to talk now, and offer to have family present. Gathering: ask first what he already knows and what worries him most ('Will I walk properly again?', 'Is my disc getting worse?'). Explaining, in plain words: the problem is not a disc but the spinal cord and the kidneys; his kidneys are losing phosphate, sugar and protein, most likely because of the adefovir he has taken for five and a half years — a known side effect of that drug; the hepatitis medicine is being changed, not stopped, because stopping it himself could make the hepatitis flare suddenly; how to take the new tablet (entecavir on an empty stomach); the phosphate tablets; the regular blood, urine and HBV DNA tests to come; and the tests still needed to rule out other causes. Be honest about uncertainty — how much his walking will recover, and whether the drug harmed the cord directly, cannot be said yet — with no false reassurance. Respond to emotion and leave time for questions; ask him to say the key points back in his own words (above all, never to stop the hepatitis tablets himself). Do not blame earlier prescribers or therapists; say the reaction will be reported as required. This case does not record what he was told.

name.zh-CN: 方医生（内科主治医师，化名）
name.en: Dr Fang (internal medicine attending, pseudonym)

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“肌张力增高、膝反射亢进和Babinski征属于哪一类体征？腰椎间盘能不能造成？”“双手Hoffmann征阳性对定位意味着什么？”“空腹血糖4.5 mmol/L，尿里为什么有糖？”“α1微球蛋白和NAG反映的是肾脏哪一部分？”“肌酐119 μmol/L够不够判断他的肾？”“他吃的哪种药会这样，为什么五年后才出现？”“如果乙肝药干脆停掉，肝硬化的他会怎样？”“恩替卡韦和丙酚替诺福韦怎么选，选之前要先知道什么？”“撤药后好转能证明什么，证明不了什么？”可以讲EASL 2025乙肝指南、我国2022年乙肝指南、阿德福韦酯说明书（2018）、NICE NG59（2016）和WHO-UMC因果评价的相关原则，也可以提醒肝性脊髓病和营养性、感染性脊髓病需要鉴别。病例结束时用PEARLS框架复盘。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；生命体征、HBV DNA、肝功能、白蛋白、凝血、血小板、血钾、碳酸氢根、碱性磷酸酶、甲状旁腺激素、维生素D、B12、铜、阿德福韦酯剂量和既往乙肝用药都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has, for example: 'Increased tone, brisk knee jerks and Babinski signs — what kind of signs are these, and can a lumbar disc cause them?', 'What do bilateral Hoffmann signs tell you about the level?', 'With a fasting glucose of 4.5 mmol/L, why is there sugar in the urine?', 'Which part of the kidney do alpha-1 microglobulin and NAG speak for?', 'Is a creatinine of 119 μmol/L enough to judge his kidneys?', 'Which of his medicines can do this, and why after five years?', 'What happens to a man with cirrhosis if his hepatitis B treatment simply stops?', 'How do you choose between entecavir and tenofovir alafenamide, and what must you know first?', 'What does improvement after withdrawal prove, and what not?'. May explain the relevant principles of the EASL 2025 hepatitis B guideline, the Chinese 2022 guideline, the adefovir label (2018), NICE NG59 (2016) and WHO-UMC causality assessment, and may remind the learner that hepatic, nutritional and infective myelopathies need excluding. Debriefs with PEARLS at the end. Never states the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early; vital signs, HBV DNA, liver function, albumin, clotting, platelets, potassium, bicarbonate, alkaline phosphatase, PTH, vitamin D, B12, copper, the adefovir dose and earlier hepatitis B drugs are not recorded — do not supply them.

name.zh-CN: 唐护士（病房护士，化名）
name.en: Nurse Tang (ward nurse, pseudonym)

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：情况——63岁男性入院，腰痛、行走进行性困难一年半，双腿发麻出现得更早；背景——乙肝肝硬化、静脉曲张做过套扎、脾大，长期吃一种乙肝药，此前按腰椎间盘问题做过按摩理疗，没有好转；评估——下地走路需要有人搀扶，跌倒风险高；他的生命体征本病例没有记录；建议——请医生评估，先落实防跌倒措施。病房条件：可以抽血、留尿送检，床旁有膀胱扫描仪，MRI在影像科，需要时由护工和她送他过去；病历终端在护士站。可以按医嘱抽血、留尿、测残余尿、发药、安排助行器和陪同下床、联系会诊和陪同检查。复述医嘱，只报告已经发生的事和已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；问到没有记录的内容（生命体征、体重、既往用药细节）就如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): Situation — a 63-year-old man admitted with a year and a half of low back pain and progressively harder walking; his legs went numb before that. Background — hepatitis B cirrhosis, varices banded, an enlarged spleen; he takes a hepatitis B tablet long-term; massage and physiotherapy for a presumed disc problem did not help. Assessment — he needs someone to support him to walk, so his falls risk is high; his vital signs are not recorded in this case. Recommendation — please assess him; falls precautions first. Ward kit: bloods and urine samples can be sent, there is a bladder scanner at the bedside, MRI is in radiology and she and a porter can take him there; the records terminal is at the nurses' station. Can, on instruction, take bloods, collect urine, scan the bladder, give medicines, set up a walking aid and supervised mobilising, call the consulting teams and escort him to tests. Reads back orders, reports only what has happened and results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (vital signs, weight, details of his earlier medicines).

name.zh-CN: 邱医生（肝病科，化名）
name.en: Dr Qiu (hepatology, pseudonym)

knowledge.zh-CN: 肝病科医生，只解读学员已经看过的资料。可以讲：EASL 2025乙肝指南——低磷血症、肾功能不全或有TDF肾毒性危险因素时优先用丙酚替诺福韦，恩替卡韦为替代；从阿德福韦酯换药时，只有没用过拉米夫定才首选恩替卡韦；进展期肝病在HBsAg消失前不应停药；达到病毒学应答前每3–6个月查HBV DNA。我国2022年指南——用阿德福韦酯或TDF的患者出现肾脏或骨骼疾病时改用恩替卡韦或TAF，并定期查肌酐和血磷。说明书——阿德福韦酯停药后肝炎加重最多25%，肝硬化者失代偿风险更高；恩替卡韦空腹，代偿期0.5 mg、失代偿期1 mg，肌酐清除率<50 mL/min时调整；丙酚替诺福韦25 mg随餐，不推荐用于Child-Pugh B、C级。会问学员：他以前用过拉米夫定吗？肝硬化是代偿还是失代偿？——这两点本病例都没有记录，需要查。不说出诊断，不透露结局；HBV DNA、肝功能、Child-Pugh分级和阿德福韦酯剂量都没有记录，不要补上。
knowledge.en: Hepatologist who interprets only what the learner has already read. Can explain: the EASL 2025 hepatitis B guideline — tenofovir alafenamide is preferred in hypophosphataemia, renal insufficiency or other risk factors for TDF nephrotoxicity, with entecavir as the alternative; after adefovir, entecavir is first choice only if lamivudine was never used; NAs should not be stopped in advanced liver disease before HBsAg loss; HBV DNA every 3–6 months until a virological response. The Chinese 2022 guideline — patients on adefovir or TDF who develop kidney or bone disease change to entecavir or TAF, with regular creatinine and phosphate checks. The labels — hepatitis flares in up to 25 % after stopping adefovir, with a higher risk of decompensation in cirrhosis; entecavir on an empty stomach, 0.5 mg compensated or 1 mg decompensated, adjusted below a creatinine clearance of 50 mL/min; TAF 25 mg with food, not recommended in Child-Pugh B or C. Asks the learner: has he had lamivudine before, and is the cirrhosis compensated? — neither is recorded in this case and both need finding out. Does not state the diagnosis or reveal the outcome; HBV DNA, liver function, the Child-Pugh class and the adefovir dose are not recorded — do not supply them.

name.zh-CN: 严医生（肾内科，化名）
name.en: Dr Yan (nephrology, pseudonym)

knowledge.zh-CN: 肾内科医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：血糖正常时的尿糖是肾性糖尿；α1微球蛋白升高是低分子量（小管性）蛋白尿，NAG升高提示小管上皮损伤；低磷、低尿酸加上这些，是近端肾小管广泛功能障碍（范科尼综合征）的表现；还应查尿磷排泄（磷排泄分数或TmP/GFR）、碳酸氢根和血钾（近端肾小管酸中毒）、尿氨基酸，成人还可筛查单克隆轻链。肌酐119 μmol/L按CKD-EPI 2021公式估算eGFR约59 mL/min/1.73 m²，只是单次数值，肝硬化患者肌肉量少，可能高估真实肾功能，而且反映不出小管损伤。撤药后小管恢复需要数周到数月，可能不完全。不说出诊断结论，不透露结局；碳酸氢根、血钾、尿磷、尿pH和白蛋白都没有记录，不要补上。
knowledge.en: Nephrologist who interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain: glycosuria at a normal blood glucose is renal glycosuria; a raised alpha-1 microglobulin is low-molecular-weight (tubular) proteinuria and a raised NAG marks tubular cell injury; with a low phosphate and urate these make up a generalised proximal tubulopathy (Fanconi syndrome); the work-up adds urine phosphate excretion (fractional excretion or TmP/GFR), bicarbonate and potassium (proximal renal tubular acidosis), urine amino acids, and in an adult a screen for a monoclonal light chain. A creatinine of 119 μmol/L gives an eGFR of about 59 mL/min/1.73 m² by CKD-EPI 2021 — a single value that may overestimate function in cirrhosis, where muscle mass is low, and that does not show tubular injury. Tubular recovery after withdrawal takes weeks to months and may be incomplete. Does not state the diagnosis or reveal the outcome; bicarbonate, potassium, urine phosphate, urine pH and albumin are not recorded — do not supply them.

name.zh-CN: 温药师（临床药师，化名）
name.en: Pharmacist Wen (clinical pharmacist, pseudonym)

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师。可以讲说明书要点：阿德福韦酯（2018）——上市后报告有范科尼综合征、近端肾小管病、低磷血症、肌病和骨软化症（表现为骨痛，可致骨折），肾毒性可迟发；与非甾体抗炎药等肾毒性药物合用要警惕；停药后可出现严重肝炎加重。恩替卡韦——空腹服用，代偿期0.5 mg、拉米夫定耐药或失代偿期1 mg，肌酐清除率<50 mL/min时调整。丙酚替诺福韦——25 mg随餐，不推荐用于Child-Pugh B、C级肝硬化。唑来膦酸——低钙血症和肌酐清除率<35 mL/min时禁用。也可以讲药品不良反应上报（《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》，2011）和WHO-UMC因果评价。只知道他在吃阿德福韦酯、吃了五年半；剂量、既往乙肝用药、体重和肌酐清除率都没有记录，不要补上；不说出诊断，不透露结局。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist. Can explain the labels: adefovir (2018) — postmarketing reports of Fanconi syndrome, proximal tubulopathy, hypophosphataemia, myopathy and osteomalacia (bone pain, possible fractures), nephrotoxicity of delayed onset, caution with nephrotoxic co-medication such as NSAIDs, and severe hepatitis flares after stopping. Entecavir — on an empty stomach, 0.5 mg in compensated disease and 1 mg with lamivudine resistance or decompensation, adjusted below a creatinine clearance of 50 mL/min. Tenofovir alafenamide — 25 mg with food, not recommended in Child-Pugh B or C cirrhosis. Zoledronic acid — contraindicated in hypocalcaemia and below a creatinine clearance of 35 mL/min. Can also explain adverse-drug-reaction reporting (China's 2011 provisions) and WHO-UMC causality assessment. Knows only that he takes adefovir and has done for five and a half years; the dose, earlier hepatitis B drugs, weight and creatinine clearance are not recorded — do not supply them; does not state the diagnosis or reveal the outcome.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：腰痛、行走困难与一种长期服用的药
title.en: Debrief: back pain, failing walking and a long-term medicine

conclusion.zh-CN: 63岁男性，乙肝肝硬化（静脉曲张已套扎、脾大），连续服用阿德福韦酯五年半；腰痛、行走进行性困难一年半，双腿发麻更早出现（先左脚、后右腿），偶有小便失禁，胸部有紧束感；按腰椎间盘问题按摩理疗无效。查体：双下肢肌张力增高、膝反射亢进、双侧Babinski征和Hoffmann征阳性，肌力V级，步基稍宽、需搀扶——这是脊髓病，不是腰椎间盘问题。血磷0.37 mmol/L、尿酸122 μmol/L、钙1.97 mmol/L、肌酐119 μmol/L、空腹血糖4.5 mmol/L；尿糖、尿蛋白阳性，α1微球蛋白257.8 mg/L、NAG 90 U/L——近端肾小管广泛功能障碍。MRI未见胸段髓外占位、轻度退变；神经电生理示双下肢深感觉传导径路阻滞。原报告把阿德福韦酯换为恩替卡韦并补充营养和骨代谢治疗：血磷数周内改善，5个月后行走恢复正常，尿小管指标明显下降但部分仍异常；文题诊断为阿德福韦酯相关范科尼综合征合并脊髓病及周围神经病。撤药后好转支持药物关联，但换药与补充治疗同时进行，神经受累的机制仍未证实。
conclusion.en: A 63-year-old man with hepatitis B cirrhosis (varices banded, an enlarged spleen) had taken adefovir continuously for five and a half years. For a year and a half he had back pain and progressively harder walking, with numb legs that began earlier — first the left foot, then the right leg — occasional urinary incontinence and a tight, band-like feeling in the chest; massage and physiotherapy for a presumed disc problem had not helped. Increased tone in both legs, brisk knee reflexes, bilateral Babinski and Hoffmann signs, power grade V and a slightly wide-based gait needing support made this a myelopathy, not a disc. Phosphate 0.37 mmol/L, urate 122 μmol/L, calcium 1.97 mmol/L, creatinine 119 μmol/L and fasting glucose 4.5 mmol/L, with urine glucose and protein positive, alpha-1 microglobulin 257.8 mg/L and NAG 90 U/L, showed a generalised proximal tubulopathy. MRI showed no thoracic extramedullary mass and mild degenerative change; neurophysiology showed impaired deep-sensation conduction in both legs. The report switched adefovir to entecavir with nutritional and bone-metabolism treatment: the phosphate improved within weeks, he walked normally at five months, and the tubular markers fell markedly though some stayed abnormal. Its title names adefovir-associated Fanconi syndrome with myelopathy and peripheral neuropathy. Recovery after withdrawal supports the drug's role, but because the switch and the supportive treatment came together, how the cord and nerves were affected remains unproven.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 双下肢上运动神经元体征加双侧Hoffmann征、小便失禁和胸部紧束感，把问题定位在颈髓或更高水平的脊髓——压迫腰段神经根的腰椎间盘解释不了这些体征，按摩理疗无效也就说得通了。
keyReasoning.en: Upper motor neurone signs in the legs with bilateral Hoffmann signs, urinary incontinence and a tight, bound chest place the problem in the cord at or above the neck — a lumbar disc, pressing on roots below the cord, cannot explain them, which is why massage and physiotherapy did nothing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 空腹血糖4.5 mmol/L时出现尿糖，α1微球蛋白和NAG升高，血磷和尿酸都低：近端小管没能把该回收的东西收回来，尽管肌酐只有119 μmol/L。
keyReasoning.en: Glycosuria with a fasting glucose of 4.5 mmol/L, a high alpha-1 microglobulin and NAG, and a low phosphate and urate mean the proximal tubule is failing to reclaim what it should — even though the creatinine is only 119 μmol/L.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 记录中唯一的长期用药阿德福韦酯是核苷酸类似物，以迟发的近端小管毒性、低磷和骨软化著称；症状在服药约四年后出现，符合累积性毒性，而不是急性反应。
keyReasoning.en: The one recorded long-term drug, adefovir, is a nucleotide analogue known for delayed proximal tubular toxicity with hypophosphataemia and osteomalacia; symptoms beginning about four years into treatment fit a cumulative toxicity rather than an acute one.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 处理要撤掉这个药，又不能让乙肝失去治疗：当天换成没有这种毒性的抗病毒药，按既往用药和肝功能选药定量，同时补上小管仍在丢失的磷。
keyReasoning.en: The answer is to remove the drug without leaving the hepatitis B untreated: a same-day switch to an antiviral without that toxicity, chosen and dosed by his earlier drugs and liver function, plus replacement of the phosphate the tubule is still losing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 神经方面的关联比肾脏方面弱：换药和补充治疗同时开始，好转支持关联，却分不出作用机制，可以治疗的脊髓病病因仍需排除。
keyReasoning.en: The neurological link is weaker than the renal one: the switch and the supportive treatment started together, so recovery supports an association without isolating the mechanism, and treatable causes of myelopathy still need excluding.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能确定阿德福韦酯损伤脊髓和周围神经的机制，也不能比较不同处理的效果。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。病房、各阶段的划分、检查开出和回报的时间、医护人员及其对话都是教学安排；生命体征、肝功能、HBV DNA、阿德福韦酯剂量、既往乙肝用药和换药后的数值都没有记录，本病例不作补充。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot establish how adefovir affected the cord and peripheral nerves, or compare treatments. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The ward, the phases, when tests are ordered and reported, and the staff and their dialogue are teaching arrangements; vital signs, liver function, HBV DNA, the adefovir dose, earlier hepatitis B drugs and any values after the switch are not recorded, and the case adds none.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何阶段的生命体征、体重和身高。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, weight and height at any stage.

unknowns.zh-CN: HBV DNA、HBeAg、肝功能、白蛋白、凝血、血小板，以及肝硬化是代偿期还是失代偿期（Child-Pugh分级）。
unknowns.en: HBV DNA, HBeAg, liver function, albumin, clotting, platelets, and whether the cirrhosis was compensated or decompensated (Child-Pugh class).

unknowns.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯的剂量和给药间隔、此前用过哪些乙肝药（如拉米夫定）及有无耐药，以及服药期间是否监测过肾功能和血磷。
unknowns.en: The adefovir dose and interval, which hepatitis B drugs came before it (for example lamivudine) and any resistance, and whether kidney function and phosphate were monitored during treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血钾、碳酸氢根、镁、碱性磷酸酶、甲状旁腺激素、维生素D，尿磷排泄（磷排泄分数或TmP/GFR）、尿pH和尿氨基酸，以及尿糖、尿蛋白的程度。
unknowns.en: Potassium, bicarbonate, magnesium, alkaline phosphatase, PTH and vitamin D; urine phosphate excretion (fractional excretion or TmP/GFR), urine pH and amino acids; and the grade of the glycosuria and proteinuria.

unknowns.zh-CN: 记录之外的神经系统评估：颈髓是否做过影像、脊髓内信号、神经传导的具体结果、维生素B12、铜、HIV、梅毒和HTLV-1，以及深感觉、感觉平面、上肢肌力和大便情况的查体。
unknowns.en: The neurological work-up beyond the record: whether the cervical cord was imaged, the cord signal, the nerve-conduction details, B12, copper, HIV, syphilis and HTLV-1, and examination of joint-position and vibration sense, a sensory level, upper-limb power and bowel function.

unknowns.zh-CN: 恩替卡韦的剂量、营养和骨代谢治疗的具体内容、换药后的数值、哪些小管指标仍异常，以及5个月以后的随访。
unknowns.en: The entecavir dose, what the nutritional and bone-metabolism treatment contained, any values after the switch, which tubular markers stayed abnormal, and follow-up beyond five months.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 腰痛加腿部症状不一定是腰椎间盘：肌张力增高、腱反射亢进、Babinski征和Hoffmann征以及括约肌障碍是脊髓病变的上运动神经元表现，Hoffmann征把病变定在颈髓或更高——要做颈、胸段脊髓MRI。NICE NG59（2016）要求在按非特异性腰痛处理之前考虑其他诊断、排除特殊原因；本例此前的按摩理疗没有效果。
teachingPoints.en: Back pain with leg symptoms is not always a disc: increased tone, brisk reflexes, Babinski and Hoffmann signs and sphincter disturbance are upper motor neurone signs of a cord lesion, and Hoffmann signs put it at the cervical cord or above — image the cervical and thoracic cord. NICE NG59 (2016) asks clinicians to consider other diagnoses and exclude specific causes before managing back pain as non-specific; here, massage and physiotherapy for a presumed disc had failed.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肌酐看不出肾小管损伤：肾性糖尿（血糖正常而尿糖阳性）、α1微球蛋白等低分子量蛋白尿、NAG升高、低磷和低尿酸提示近端小管病。EASL 2025乙肝指南指出单看肌酐可能反映不出肾损害，蛋白尿或磷排泄分数更敏感；我国2022年乙肝指南要求服用阿德福韦酯或TDF者定期查血肌酐和血磷。
teachingPoints.en: Creatinine misses tubular injury: renal glycosuria (glucose in the urine at a normal blood glucose), low-molecular-weight proteinuria such as alpha-1 microglobulin, a raised NAG, hypophosphataemia and hypouricaemia identify a proximal tubulopathy. The EASL 2025 hepatitis B guideline notes that creatinine alone may not reflect renal damage and that proteinuria or fractional phosphate excretion are more sensitive; the Chinese 2022 guideline asks for regular creatinine and phosphate checks in anyone on adefovir or TDF.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯说明书（Hepsera，2018年修订）列有上市后报告的范科尼综合征、近端肾小管病、低磷血症和表现为骨痛的骨软化症，并说明肾毒性可迟发；EASL 2025指南已不再推荐阿德福韦酯作为一线药物。本例在连续服药五年半后才被发现。
teachingPoints.en: Adefovir's label (Hepsera, revised 2018) lists postmarketing Fanconi syndrome, proximal renal tubulopathy, hypophosphataemia and osteomalacia presenting as bone pain, and describes nephrotoxicity of delayed onset; EASL 2025 no longer recommends adefovir first line. In this patient it came to light after five and a half years of continuous treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 换药，绝不停药：EASL 2025指南在低磷血症、肾功能不全或其他肾脏危险因素时优先推荐丙酚替诺福韦，恩替卡韦为替代（从阿德福韦酯换药时，只有没用过拉米夫定才首选恩替卡韦），并建议进展期肝病在HBsAg消失前不停药；我国2022年指南建议已用阿德福韦酯或TDF者出现肾脏或骨骼疾病时改用恩替卡韦或TAF。原报告把阿德福韦酯换成了恩替卡韦。
teachingPoints.en: Switch, never stop: EASL 2025 prefers tenofovir alafenamide in hypophosphataemia, renal insufficiency or other renal risk, with entecavir as the alternative (after adefovir, entecavir only if lamivudine was never used), and advises against stopping NAs in advanced liver disease before HBsAg loss; the Chinese 2022 guideline advises changing adefovir or TDF to entecavir or TAF when kidney or bone disease develops. The report changed adefovir to entecavir.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 用标准工具判断因果：按WHO-UMC系统，时间关系合理、撤药后反应合理、又没有更好的解释，不需再激发即可评为“很可能”。本例小管指标好转符合这一点；行走恢复时补磷和骨代谢治疗也在进行，药物是否直接损伤脊髓和神经仍未证实——文题写的是脊髓病和周围神经病，可治疗的病因仍需排除。
teachingPoints.en: Judge causality with a standard tool: on the WHO-UMC system, a plausible time course, a reasonable response to withdrawal and no better explanation make a reaction 'probable' without rechallenge. The tubular improvement here fits that; his walking recovered while phosphate and bone treatment were also given, so a direct effect of the drug on the cord and nerves remains unproven — the title names myelopathy and peripheral neuropathy, but treatable causes still need excluding.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 上报并教会患者：《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》（2011）要求医疗机构报告药品不良反应；同时要让他记住乙肝药绝不能自己停——说明书（2018）记载停药后可出现严重肝炎加重，肝硬化者风险更高，并有死亡病例。
teachingPoints.en: Report it and teach the patient: China's adverse-drug-reaction provisions (2011) require medical institutions to report adverse drug reactions, and he must know never to stop his hepatitis B tablets himself — the label (2018) records severe flares after stopping, with a higher risk in cirrhosis and deaths reported.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何阶段的生命体征、体重和身高。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, weight and height at any stage.

unknowns.zh-CN: HBV DNA、HBeAg、肝功能、白蛋白、凝血、血小板，以及肝硬化是代偿期还是失代偿期（Child-Pugh分级）。
unknowns.en: HBV DNA, HBeAg, liver function, albumin, clotting, platelets, and whether the cirrhosis was compensated or decompensated (Child-Pugh class).

unknowns.zh-CN: 阿德福韦酯的剂量和给药间隔、此前用过哪些乙肝药（如拉米夫定）及有无耐药，以及服药期间是否监测过肾功能和血磷。
unknowns.en: The adefovir dose and interval, which hepatitis B drugs came before it (for example lamivudine) and any resistance, and whether kidney function and phosphate were monitored during treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血钾、碳酸氢根、镁、碱性磷酸酶、甲状旁腺激素、维生素D，尿磷排泄（磷排泄分数或TmP/GFR）、尿pH和尿氨基酸，以及尿糖、尿蛋白的程度。
unknowns.en: Potassium, bicarbonate, magnesium, alkaline phosphatase, PTH and vitamin D; urine phosphate excretion (fractional excretion or TmP/GFR), urine pH and amino acids; and the grade of the glycosuria and proteinuria.

unknowns.zh-CN: 记录之外的神经系统评估：颈髓是否做过影像、脊髓内信号、神经传导的具体结果、维生素B12、铜、HIV、梅毒和HTLV-1，以及深感觉、感觉平面、上肢肌力和大便情况的查体。
unknowns.en: The neurological work-up beyond the record: whether the cervical cord was imaged, the cord signal, the nerve-conduction details, B12, copper, HIV, syphilis and HTLV-1, and examination of joint-position and vibration sense, a sensory level, upper-limb power and bowel function.

unknowns.zh-CN: 恩替卡韦的剂量、营养和骨代谢治疗的具体内容、换药后的数值、哪些小管指标仍异常，以及5个月以后的随访。
unknowns.en: The entecavir dose, what the nutritional and bone-metabolism treatment contained, any values after the switch, which tubular markers stayed abnormal, and follow-up beyond five months.
